Interviewee: Foreststorn “Chico” Hamilton (September 21, 1921 – November 25, Interviewer: Dr. Anthony Brown with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript 150 pp.

Today is January 9, 2006. This is the official Smithsonian Jazz Oral History interview with Chico Hamilton in his home on 45th Street in New York City. This is a partnership with the National Endowment for the Arts Jazz Masters program. Good afternoon, Chico Hamilton. If we could begin by you stating your full name and your date and place of birth, please.
